title: erodium cicutarium var. filicinum
intro: Erodium cicutarium var. filicinum, commonly known as filiform Stork's bill, is a plant species within the geranium family (Geraniaceae). This plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of digestive issues, such as dyspepsia, and its use as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cicutarium var. filicinum include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its use in treating fever and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
